method.purpose: Conservative ordinal screening of supplied manual evidence scores, not scientific estimates of C or H.
method.dimension_aggregation: Within each dimension and HR scenario, select the minimum supplied score; flag distinct-score conflicts; never average or assign missing scores.
method.subsystem_aggregation: Minimum of all 10 metric scores only when all 10 are known.
method.domain_aggregation: Minimum of all 10 complete subsystem scores only when all 100 dimension scores are known.
method.system_aggregation: Minimum of ontology-tagged critical dimensions only when every such dimension is known; criticality tags are not a verified dependency or critical-path graph.
method.unknown_policy: Unknown is null, never zero. observed_min ignores unknowns solely to summarize observed scores and must be read with its adjacent coverage counts.
method.single_point_of_failure: reported_spof_assessments preserves explicit source-record assertions, including No and Unknown; these are not computed or independently verified SPOFs and are not ranked.

limitations: The 0–5 scale is ordinal; normalization and ratios are explicitly versioned screening conventions, not calibrated physical measurements.
Complete ontology coverage does not establish jointly necessary or sufficient industrial closure, comparable experimental boundaries, or independent corroboration.
Different evidence systems, operating durations, and human roles are not automatically harmonized; a conservative minimum does not resolve their substantive differences.
No scores are assigned from research JSON, source counts, search coverage, confidence labels, or absent evidence.
R_M and g_0 require separate reproduction and longitudinal growth measurements and remain unestimated.

proxy_explanations.C_proxy: Unknown: HR0 has scores for 0 of 600 ontology-tagged critical dimensions; a nonempty complete critical set is required.
proxy_explanations.H_proxy: Unknown: complete nonempty critical-dimension scores are required in both HR0 and HR100.
proxy_explanations.R_M: Not estimated: no machine-system reproduction measurement is provided by this scoring workflow.
proxy_explanations.g_0: Not estimated: no longitudinal human-free growth measurement is provided by this scoring workflow.
